decode_layout: The ENTIRE input buffer is the message (any length, incl. 0). Split into 31-byte big-endian chunks; each chunk is right-aligned into a 32-byte buffer and read as a Felt via Felt::from_bytes_be. Output: the 32-byte big-endian Poseidon hash (Felt::to_bytes_be). DECODE is total: empty input yields zero chunks.
